original_target.title: Low-degree convergence of relaxed minimal-deformation surface elements
original_target.outcome: Partial: one admissible linear counterexample and cubic convergence; degree two remains unresolved.

scope_comparison: The current local manuscript already records a failing admissible linear torus family and h^3 sqrt(log) convergence for all admissible cubic families, while its quadratic-open remark explicitly retains degree two. It uses fixed reference measure and discontinuous geometric normals; projected/averaged-normal MDR and Willmore/Helfrich energy laws differ.
